# HORN-Z1 — Chinese Room

This note executes the canonical `maps/chinese-room-slice.horn.json` artifact through the native `%horn` interpreter. HORN owns meaning and authored geometry; Zeppelin owns interaction and execution; Celix owns ephemeral reasoning composition.

paragraphs.title: Authority boundary
paragraphs.text:
%md
## Authority boundary

The `%horn` interpreter is deliberately thin. Presentation views use the TypeScript adapter; headless validation, query, explanation, impact, diff, and inspection use the pinned Celix-discovered libhorn services. For composed paragraphs, Zeppelin transports an opaque note-scoped `horn-reasoning-session/0.1` envelope while `IReasoningSessionService` owns binding resolution and service dispatch. Derived results can feed later service operands but can never replace canonical `.horn.json` document operands.
